reviews.decision_reason: The unit preserved all demand-bearing corpus rows into the selected needs handoff with record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight intact. The package does not include underlying market-demand observations, so customer-demand substantiation cannot be independently judged here, but no behaviorally significant transformation fault is visible in this boundary.

The normalized needs output retained the existing record identifiers and fields for the selected records and preserved the bounded set of eight needs. No contradiction or unrelated candidate is visible in the supplied semantic package.

The provenance assembly handoff contains the same eight record identifiers and source identifiers ranked deterministically in descending demand provenance order matching the supplied upstream needs. This supports the downstream deterministic recommendation input, and no behaviorally significant fault is localized to this boundary.
